name: What should I consider when choosing a comfort height toilet?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a comfort height toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a comfort height toilet, consider the rough-in measurement (distance from wall to drain pipe) to ensure compatibility. Evaluate different flushing systems, such as dual-flush or pressure-assisted, for water efficiency and performance. Also, think about bowl shape (round vs. elongated) for comfort and space, and features like low-flow certification. Finally, consider the aesthetic design to match your bathroom decor. Our team can assist in selecting a model that meets your specific needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider rough-in measurement, flushing system, bowl shape, water efficiency, and aesthetic design when choosing a comfort height toilet.
